svg.title: Data platform
svg.desc: Three source feeds are ingested, validated and merged into a lakehouse, where a batch engine cleans and curates the data through bronze, silver and gold zones before a warehouse serves it to dashboards and an API. Four scenarios: the nightly batch, a bad record, a self-serve query and a backfill.

g.aria-label: Send a bad record: play Bad record
Run a query: play Self-serve query

svg.text: All three feeds are pulled at once.
Each feed checks its records against the feed's schema.
The validated records are merged and landed as raw tables.
The batch engine deduplicates, joins, enriches and aggregates, writing clean tables.
The data marts are rebuilt and published to the warehouse.
